Sri Ranga Ranganathanin HD Video Song from Mahanadhi Tamil Movie featuring Kamal Haasan and Sukanya on Mango Music Tamil. Music by Ilayaraja. Mahanadhi Tamil movie also features Shobana, Poornam Viswanathan and Cochin Haneefa among others. Directed by Santhana Bharathi and produced by S. A. Rajkannu.
Song : Sri Ranga Ranganathanin
Singers : Mahanadhi Shobana, SPB
Lyrics : Vaali
